fact: A decree creating the Cellule Centrafricaine de l'Internet et de la Sécurité (CCIS), a national cyber body at the Presidency, was issued in December 2024, and decrees on its organisation and its Coordinator followed in January 2025.
title: Historique
publisher: Cellule Centrafricaine de l'Internet et de la Sécurité (CCIS)
